# Version 4.151.2
> **Engine servicing refresh** · Released August 29, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.102/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.2 incorporates Chrome M151 servicing without changing the managed API. The HarfBuzzSharp package revision moves to the M151 servicing bucket; this does not represent a native HarfBuzz upgrade.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **M151 servicing** — Refreshes the bundled engine within milestone 151 without adding managed wrappers or changing generated bindings. ([#4692](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4692))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.102

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
